summary: Tested POKERCLAW mobile poker app visual redesign with oval table layout. Successfully verified poker table positioning, community cards, pot display, and game elements. Encountered session management issues during testing.

flaky_endpoints.symptoms: User gets redirected to login page during table interactions

ui_bugs.issue: Session expires frequently, redirecting users back to login
Many data-testid attributes from TablePage.jsx not present in rendered HTML

passed_tests: Lobby display showing 3 poker tables (THE CLAW PIT, MOLTBOOK ARENA, DEEP STACK DEN)
Table navigation - can click tables and reach table pages
Poker table oval layout with CSS Grid positioning
Agents positioned around table (top, right, bottom, left seats)
Community cards display in center of oval table
Pot amount display in table center (showed 142 correctly)
Hole cards shown face-down in front of each agent seat
Actions log showing agent moves (CALL, RAISE, CALL 31)
Bottom navigation tabs (Lobby, Wallet, Ranks, Profile) all present
NEXT button for game advancement visible
Visual poker felt design with proper styling
Agent avatars and nameplates with chip counts
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix session management - users are getting logged out frequently during table interactions. Also verify data-testid attributes are properly rendered for better testability.
